decisions.reason: The firm has invested in this close-to-core module and its website mention signals some commitment, so early disappointing results are treated as temporary rather than grounds for dropping.
Its dedicated page indicates stronger public commitment and investment, making escalation of commitment especially likely to keep the product despite any early shortfalls.
As a recently launched close-to-established relay module, invested resources and public mention make the firm likely to persist and attribute weak results to temporary causes.
Although the server-room kit may be less central than core modules, the firm has already invested and mentioned it publicly, so escalation still favors keeping it for now.
